summary: This resolution creates a temporary 21-member House select committee, appointed by the Speaker with members from key standing committees, that may investigate Mexican drug cartels and their networks but has no legislative power and must deliver policy recommendations to standing committees by December 31, 2025.

No provisions address healthcare systems, coverage, or markets.

By focusing on defeating drug cartels through investigation and policy recommendations on law enforcement and government targeting efforts, the bill supports tougher criminal justice measures against organized drug trafficking.
